description: This file defines data type classes and mappings for numpy-like dtypes supported by PyTorch, including scalar types, type aliases, and functions for dtype management and conversion.

classes.name: generic
classes.description: Base class for scalar types, models numpy scalars as 0-D arrays.

classes.name: inexact
classes.description: Abstract type for inexact (floating point or complex) scalars.

classes.name: signedinteger
classes.description: Abstract type for signed integer scalars.

classes.name: unsignedinteger
classes.description: Abstract type for unsigned integer scalars.

classes.name: floating
classes.description: Abstract type for floating point scalars.

classes.name: complexfloating
classes.description: Abstract type for complex floating point scalars.

methods.name: sctype_from_string
methods.description: Normalize a string to a dtype class.

methods.name: sctype_from_torch_dtype
methods.description: Get scalar type class from torch dtype.

methods.name: dtype
methods.description: Create a DType instance from an argument.

methods.name: set_default_dtype
methods.description: Set global default dtypes for float, complex, and int types.

methods.name: issubdtype
methods.description: Check if one dtype is a subtype of another.
